newsitem.title: USA: Delta has no comment on Boeing report.
newsitem.headline: Delta has no comment on Boeing report.

text.p: Delta Air Lines Inc declined comment on Wednesday about a newspaper report that said Boeing Co may change its sole-supplier pacts with U.S. airlines.

The article, which appeared in Wednesday editions of the Wall Street Journal, said Boeing may seek to pacify European leaders and remove a major obstacle to its acquisition of McDonnell Douglas Corp by offering to alter its agreements with Delta, AMR Corp's American Airlines and Continental Airlines Inc.

"There are speculative reports, and Delta does not comment on speculation in the industry," Delta spokesman Todd Clay said when asked about the claims in the article, which cited "people familiar with the situation" as sources.

European antitrust officials contend that the agreements, which require the three carriers to buy planes exclusively from Boeing over the next two decades, show the company is already abusing its dominant position in the market.
